svg.title: Attitude error from a 359 degree start, naive vs sign-corrected
svg.desc: Software-in-the-loop run of sketch.ino against chip.chip.c. The naive law rotates the long way, peaking at 179 degrees of error at 3.5 s and settling after 5.6 s; the sign-corrected law stays within 1 degree.
svg.text: From 359°, the naive law goes the long way round
Attitude error vs time · software-in-the-loop, sketch.ino against chip.chip.c
